headline: Nuclearelectrica invoked force majeure in energy delivery contracts due to the drying up of the Danube — Electrica, PPC and Engie are among SNN's largest energy buyers
summary: Nuclearelectrica invoked the force majeure clause in electricity delivery contracts due to severe drought on the Danube. Electrica, PPC and Engie are named among its largest energy buyers.
why: Force majeure lets a supplier suspend contractual delivery obligations after events beyond its control. Nuclear plants on the Danube rely on river water for cooling, so drought can curb output.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: Nuclearelectrica a invocat forța majoră în contractele de livrare a energiei, din cauza secării Dunării - Electrica, PPC și Engie sunt printre cei mai mari cumpărători de energie ai SNN
